name: ZBP Endpoint DLP Baseline
description: Zscaler best-practice Endpoint DLP golden configuration, ported from the zbp-automation Terraform module: three parent rules (sensitive data to USB, to unapproved desktop GenAI applications, to network/private shares) with five sub-rules that grade the response by PCI engine confidence (block / confirm / allow-and-log), plus the zbp-GenAI Applications endpoint application group (ChatGPT and Claude desktop apps on Windows and macOS, by Zscaler catalogue ID). PCI - High/Medium/Low engines are shipped on the predefined Credit Cards dictionary and reused if the tenant already has them. All rules ship DISABLED at INFO.
references: Zscaler: Configuring Endpoint DLP Rules and Sub-rules
notes: Endpoint DLP needs Zscaler Client Connector with the Endpoint DLP module (ZDP) deployed; the assessment's Endpoint DLP section and preflight's Tenant prerequisites say whether the API answers.

Sub-rules are created under their parent (POST /endPointDlpRules/{parent}/subRule) after the parent exists, in the order listed. The tenant returns them inside the parent rule; the planner matches them by name.

The application group is built from Zscaler well-known catalogue IDs (zappId), not tenant object IDs, so it carries no source-tenant dependency. ZIA accepts the group association on create but does not always return it on read (documented provider limitation); the journey check therefore does not compare it.

zbp-PCI Medium USB uses CONFIRM, which ZIA only accepts with an Endpoint DLP user confirmation template. If the tenant has none, that sub-rule fails with the API's message and the rest deploys; create the template under Administration > End User Notifications and re-run.

PCI - High/Medium/Low are defined here as 10+, 3-9 and 1-2 matches of the predefined Credit Cards dictionary. If the tenant already has engines with these names, the tenant's definitions are kept and used.
Source-tenant device trust levels and user risk scores of ANY are expanded to every explicit value, as the provider requires.
audience: Any enterprise running Zscaler Client Connector with the Endpoint DLP module: data leaving managed devices through USB, network shares and desktop GenAI apps.
when_to_use: The customer has Endpoint DLP licensed and deployed (or is about to) and wants Zscaler's best-practice starting policy for removable media, private shares and desktop AI tools, graded by PCI confidence. Pair with the ZBP Enterprise baseline for inline web DLP.
